article.story: LOUISVILLE, Ky. -- — Nils Machowski's 28 points helped Wofford defeat Bellarmine 94-86 on Saturday. Machowski shot 5 for 11 (4 for 8 from 3-point range) and 14 of 16 from the free-throw line for the Terriers (2-2). Kahmare Holmes scored 24 points and added six rebounds. Luke Flynn shot 4 of 8 from the field, including 3 for 6 from 3-point range, and went 5 for 6 from the line to finish with 16 points, while adding six rebounds. The Knights (1-3) were led by Brian Waddell and Jack Karasinski with 23 points apiece. Tyler Doyle finished with 17 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
